posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: #BlueJays win, 6-3. A massive series win in Cleveland. They now hold the tiebreaker (4-2) over the Guardians and are just a half-game back of the Wild Card. They’re 70-71 and off to Kansas City.

reply_texts.text: Love Bateman. What a trade! Suddenly, the Jays have a ton of speed…
reply_texts.author: palmtrees90.bsky.social

reply_texts.text:
That tie-breaker is huge going down the stretch. 

The Guardians also pushed their BP hard and they have a double header tomorrow.
reply_texts.author: derek.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: God our pitching looks sketchy for KC.
reply_texts.author: monkeypeter.bsky.social

posts.jp: ブルージェイズが6-3で勝利。クリーブランドでの大きなシリーズ勝利。ガーディアンズとのタイブレーカーは4-2で有利となり、ワイルドカードまで0.5ゲーム差。70-71でカンザスシティへ。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: Dylan Cease has, somehow, exceeded every lofty expectation. Story on the #BlueJays' ace, and their best hope at a run: www.mlb.com/bluejays/new...
posts.jp: ディラン・シーズはなんとか全ての高い期待を上回った。ブルージェイズのエースと彼らの最高の望みについてのストーリー。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: The Cubs have put up 5 runs on Misiorowski so far tonight to take a two-run lead in the 2nd. Bregman with another big hit, this one driving in two runs with the bases loaded.

reply_texts.text: And the Brewers are back on top 6-5 in the 4th.
reply_texts.author: notwatchingquietly.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: I’ve been a fan of this team for more than 50 years and I this is the most exhausting club to watch I can remember.
reply_texts.author: paulbadertscher.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: He can't throw 105 forever and they can always turn up the velo in the pitching machine to time him up. Bet there's film available that he has "tells" hitters can pick up. They're (hitters) are professionals with pride too.
reply_texts.author: theclevermonkey.bsky.social

posts.jp: カブスはミシオロウスキーから5点を奪い、2回に2点リードを奪取。ブレグマンが満塁の中で2点タイムリーを放つ。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: An incredible diving catch in shallow left field by Nico Hoerner with the bases loaded ends the top of the 5th and keeps the Cubs within 6-5 of the Brewers. Hoerner covered 63 feet to make the play at 27.8 feet per second.
posts.jp: ニコ・ホーナーが満塁の中、左前の浅い位置で素晴らしいダイビングキャッチ。5回表を終わらせ、カブスをブルワーズとの6-5の差を守る。ホーナーは時速27.8フィートで63フィート移動してプレーを決めた。

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: The Astros won 2-0. They are 71-69. Hayden Wesneski, AJ Blubaugh and Josh Hader threw a three-hit shutout. Nelson Velázquez got a clutch hit. The Astros have clinched the season tiebreaker over the Chicago White Sox.
posts.jp: アストロズが2-0で勝利。71-69。ウェスネスキー、ブルバウ、ハダーが3安打完封。ベラスケスが重要な安打。アストロズはホワイトソックスとのシーズンタイブレーカーを決定。

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: The Astros won 6-2. They are 72-68. Jose Altuve homered and Daulton Varsho tripled. Hunter Brown delivered a quality start. Houston took three of four from the White Sox and has a 2.5 game lead in the AL West.
posts.jp: アストロズが6-2で勝利。72-68。アルトゥーベが本塁打、バーショーが三塁打。ハンター・ブラウンが質の高いスタートを切った。ヒューストンはホワイトソックスから3勝1敗し、AL西で2.5ゲームリード。
